things that make you look
embarrassingly well read

quoting one line of poetry
at the right moment

notes in the margins
of your books

recommending the perfect book
for each friend

having read the classics,
not the summaries

knowing a little about everything.
i learn something every day on
a micro-learning app like
the Sophia app.
